title: A spending notebook you will want to open every day

mission.body: SmartWallet is made for students and young professionals who run short before month end without knowing where the money went. We want logging to take seconds, budgets to be clear, and warnings to arrive gently before you hit a limit, never as a scolding.

one.title: Quick to log, nothing to think about
one.body: Type a note and the app suggests a category. Adding an expense takes a few taps right after you pay.

two.title: Budgets that follow your payday
two.body: Your month can start on any day. See what is left and how much you can spend each day.

three.title: Timely, gentle reminders
three.body: A heads-up near 80% and when you go over, so you can adjust in time instead of being surprised at month end.

team.title: The team
team.hint: Five people, one area each, building one tidy app together.

privacy.title: Our privacy promise
privacy.lead: Money is personal. We keep it that way.

yours.title: Your data is yours.
yours.body: Export it as CSV whenever you like.

delete.title: Delete your account any time.
delete.body: Your data is erased for good after 30 days.

noSale.title: We never sell data.
noSale.body: No tracking ads, no sharing with third parties.

cta.title: Try logging your first expense
cta.body: Create a free account in under two minutes.
